# v4.4.0

###### 2026/03/15

* `Improvement` Removed the mandatory update dialog from the home page
* `Improvement` Added installation support for devices with the arm64-v8a CPU architecture
* `Dependency` Localized Auto.js APK Builder version 1.0.3
* `Dependency` Localized Root Shell version 1.6
* `Dependency` Added SwipeRefreshLayout version 1.1.0
* `Dependency` Upgraded Java version 8 -> 17
* `Dependency` Upgraded Gradle version 4.10.2 -> 8.14.3
* `Dependency` Upgraded KotlinX Coroutines version 1.0.1 -> 1.6.2
* `Dependency` Upgraded Android Annotations version 4.5.2 -> 4.8.0
* `Dependency` Upgraded ButterKnife Gradle plugin version 9.0.0-rc2 -> 10.2.3
* `Dependency` Upgraded Apache Commons version 3.3.6 -> 3.12.0
* `Dependency` Upgraded Android Analytics version 7.0.0 -> 14.2.0
* `Dependency` Upgraded CrashReport version 2.6.6 -> 4.0.4
